title: Summit and Compass
author: Mirabel Blackwood
blurb: Hazel Halloran, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
